chapter: The 1920s road: dance style and management
title: Bert Williams's comedy and Williams and Walker
summary: Bubbles describes Williams's Darktown Poker Club solo and the team Williams and Walker, comparing it to a partner leaving for better money, as Noble Sissle did.

story.theme_name: Medicine shows, minstrels, circuses and the black theater circuit
story.community_name: On the road with minstrel, carnival and tent shows

blocks.x: What kind of things did Bert Williams do?

the Dark Town Poker Club, play cards, poker and do it by himself on the stage, play poker, let you see him in a poker game which is immense. Then he had a partner -- the team was Williams and Walker before it become Bert Williams. Bert Williams become the comedian and got in this show. But Williams and Walker was a team just like Buck and Bubbles is a team and I go in another show and Buck ain't here. Bert Williams did the same thing. His wife, Bert Williams' wife -- walker's wife, she used to dress like nobody's business, you know. And they did an act that was out of this world, yet and still, Bert Williams could make more money with them Ziegfeld Follies than he could with his partner.

Same as Noble Sissle, I figured he could make more money with his band than he could with his partner, but he didn't. In my estimation he didn't. He went to the dogs it seemed to me after that, but God rest his soul, he was all right.
